name: Daytona
reason: The Daytona SDK client is only used to fetch a sandbox by id, and that answer is recorded.

name: WorkdirHarnessDriver
reason: The driver is the receiver; every field the twin reads is in its recorded private fields.

name: ^Sandbox\.(kill|create|connect|createSnapshot)$
reason: The E2B SDK's static calls; the trace checks id and options, and the answer is the provider's.

name: ^sandbox\.commands\.run$
reason: The E2B SDK runs the command in the provider; the trace checks command, timeout and env.

name: ^sandbox\.kill$
reason: The E2B SDK ends the sandbox; it takes no arguments and its result is unused.

name: ^handle\.disconnect$
reason: The E2B SDK detaches from a background command; failures are ignored by the caller.

name: ^endMeter$
reason: The stop function meterEphemeralSandbox returned; it takes no arguments and its result is unused.

name: ^new Daytona$
reason: The Daytona SDK builds a client from options the trace checks.

name: ^new Daytona\(daytonaClientOptions\(this\.#config\)\)\.get$
reason: The Daytona SDK fetches a sandbox by the id the trace checks; its state is provider data.

name: ^sandbox\.(start|createSnapshot)$
reason: The Daytona SDK acts on the provider's sandbox; the trace checks the snapshot name and timeout.

name: ^sandbox\.exec$
reason: The Workdir sandbox runs the lifecycle script the trace checks; exit code and output are provider data.

name: ^new SandboxGoneError$
reason: Constructs the error class from the message the trace checks; the twin only rethrows it.

name: ^upsertSandboxInstance$
reason: The Convex mirror write; the trace checks every argument and the answer is storage's.

name: ^recordUsage$
reason: The plan usage write; the trace checks account, amounts and attribution.

name: ^this\.#sandbox\.exposePort$
reason: The Workdir sandbox gives the public URL for the port the trace checks.

name: ^new WorkdirHarnessSession$
reason: Constructs the session from options the trace checks; the twin passes the instance on unread.

name: ^this\.#executor( \.release|\.acquireHarnessReservation|\.resumeHarnessReservation)$
reason: The injected executor, whose methods have their own recordings; the trace checks each request.

name: ^\$enter:arg[34]$
reason: Marks the recorder entering a callback this function passed; it carries no answer to trust.

name: apps/core/src/harness/sandbox/e2b-executor.ts#e2bSandboxApi
reason: A dynamic import of the e2b SDK that hands back its Sandbox class unchanged, so there is no logic to twin.

name: apps/core/src/harness/sandbox/worker-executor.ts#serializedByReservation
reason: Only chains the caller's callback per reservation; the answer is that callback's, which WorkerSandboxExecutor.run models.

name: apps/core/src/harness/sandbox/utils.ts#meterEphemeralSandbox
reason: Its mirror write never finishes inside a recording, so no recording can grade it; callers only invoke the stop function it returns.
